purpose: NeuroStrip is a 3D Slicer scripted loadable module that provides CNN-based skull stripping (brain masking) from MRI volumes using the NeuroStrip library.
summary: NeuroStrip is a well-structured 3D Slicer extension providing CNN-based skull stripping using the NeuroStrip library. All files, packaging configuration, licensing, and code implementation adhere to Slicer community standards and guidelines. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No malicious behavior, no arbitrary execution, safe temporary file usage, explicit user confirmation prior to pip installation.

environment.rationale: Installs dependencies via pip on demand with user confirmation and does not mutate global/bundled environments or alter Slicer core packages.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and catalog entry are correctly configured, all required files are present and installed appropriately.

license.rationale: Valid MIT License provided at the root level, permitting distribution and use.

soundness.rationale: Follows ScriptedLoadableModule design patterns, properly manages parameter nodes, observers, error handling, and unit testing.

utility.rationale: Clear documentation, sample data integration, unit tests, and helpful user interface.

not_checked: Exact runtime execution of the pip package install and model inference in 3D Slicer environment.
